title: Wrap and Queue — daily outreach journal
content:
Quick context: end-of-day scratchpad to capture calls, fragments, and tidy up next actions before handoff. Focus: 8 calls done, 6 voicemails, 3 strong inbound signals. Primary product hooks used today: Dedicated capacity benefits (predictable throughput), Optimize recommendations (batching -> cost down), Console tracing for observability demos.

Daily targets (personal):
- Calls: 30 dials target, 17 connected planned (today 8 connected)
- Scheduled meetings: 3 target (today 1 booked)
- SQLs to handoff: 2 target (today 1)

AM CHECKLIST (done):
- Review list: vertical filter = fintech + ads infra
- Update sequence A: add whitepaper link + compact ROI bullets
- Pull last 30-day usage for ACCT-199 (prep for demo)

CALL LIST (priority order):
1) Maya R. — Head of ML Ops, AcquisTech (connected)
   - Last touch: 2026-11-21 10:05 AM, quick discovery: worries about latency spikes in batch window
   - Notes: Interested in Dedicated; asked about autoscale burst and multi-tenant isolation.
   - Next action: Send capacity SLA one-pager + example config for burst policy by EOD (send via email, subject: Dedicated burst config).
   - Script bullets: "predictable throughput for nightly batch windows"; highlight autoscale guardrails and rollback.

2) Samir K. — VP Engineering, Marketly (left voicemail)
   - Last touch: 2026-11-21 11:40 AM (voicemail)
   - Notes: Heard from CSM referral; likely procurement Qs on private deployment networking.
   - Next action: Drop handoff to Solutions Eng (Kenzo) with Jira INF-4823 link; request intro call M/W next week.

3) Priya S. — Senior PM, Retailfy (connected)
   - Last touch: 2026-11-21 2:20 PM
   - Notes: Wants cost comparison vs current provider for 50M tokens/mo; cares about token-level cost breakdown.
   - Next action: Build quick cost model (use last Optimize tab calc) and send short spreadsheet + 15-min call to walk through.

4) Connor L. — CTO, Ingestly (no answer)
   - Last touch: 2026-11-21 3:10 PM (ring, no pickup)
   - Notes: Demo last month -> evaluating fallback policies and multi-region routing.
   - Next action: Email link to routing doc + ask for suitable time Fri morning.

5) Elise M. — Head of Analytics, AdSpan (connected)
   - Last touch: 2026-11-21 4:05 PM
   - Notes: Loves the embedding workflows; asked about latency for 512-dim embeddings at scale.
   - Next action: Send benchmark snippet, include embedding batching tip and invite to experiments program.

TEMPLATES / SNIPPET TEXTS (quick copy-paste):
- Voicemail: "Hey <Name>, Diego from Redwood Inference — quick note on predictable throughput and a one-pager that compares costs for common batch sizes. Email me back or book a quick 15-min: calendly.com/diego-redwood."
- Follow-up email after demo: "Thanks for your time — attached are the config screenshots and an example rollout plan (canary -> 50% -> 100%). Ping me if you'd like a walkthrough."

PIPELINE NOTES (open deals to nudge):
- ACCT-199 (AcquisTech) — Stage: Eval/POC; MRR potential: $18k/mo; ask: dedicated capacity and burst SLAs; next: send config (actioned).
- ACCT-223 (Marketly) — Stage: Discovery; MRR potential: $9k/mo; blocker: network constraints for private deploy; next: SE intro + network diagram (Kenzo).
- ACCT-241 (Retailfy) — Stage: Pricing; MRR potential: $12k/mo; blocker: token-cost comparison; next: cost model + 15-min review.

NOTES / Brain-dumps:
- Quick experiment idea: run a 2-week micro-pilot offering cached prefix for top-10 prompts -> measure token reduction. Ask AM for budget credit.
- If pushback on price: lead with "cost/time-to-inference" case study (reduce inference tokens via caching + batching) — have numbers from Optimize team.

ADMIN / HANDOFF (EOD):
- Slack: post summary to #sdr-daily-handoff (include 3 priority deals and blocked ask for SE) — do this now.
- Create Jira INF-5041 for Kenzo to capture private deploy network checklist (reference INF-4823).
- Sync up with Aisha tomorrow 9:30 AM to split demo follow-ups.

EVENING WRAP (short):
- Wins: Booked 1 meeting with AcquisTech POC lead. Good discovery with Retailfy on pricing.
- Misses: fewer connects than target — need revised ring times (try 8:45–10:30 AM PST).
- Tomorrow focus: finish cost model for Retailfy, SE intro for Marketly, 40 dials with vertical=adtech/fintech.
